LeetLogger 🚀

Automated, Zero-Friction LeetCode Submission Logging & Backdated Historical Catch-Up for GitHub

--- ## 🌟 Key Features - **⚡ Instant Real-Time Sync**: Automatically intercepts accepted submissions on LeetCode, formats structured markdown problem statements with badges, and commits code files directly to your target GitHub repository. - **📜 Historical Catch-Up Engine (Backdated Bulk Sync)**: Scans your target GitHub repository tree against your complete LeetCode solved archive and commits missing solutions with their **exact historical solve timestamps** (`author.date` / `committer.date`), populating your authentic GitHub contribution graph. - **🔄 Durable Offline Queue**: Network blips or rate limits never lose code. Failed transactions persist in `chrome.storage.local` with automatic exponential backoff retry. - **🎨 Glassmorphic React 18 Dashboard**: Sleek popup status tracker and options configuration dashboard styled with modern Vanilla CSS. - **🛡️ Direct Peer-to-Peer Security**: Zero intermediate servers, telemetry proxies, or data aggregators. Direct, authenticated communication between the browser and GitHub APIs. --- ## 🏗️ Architecture Overview ```mermaid graph TD subgraph BrowserContext["Browser Context"] CS["Content Scripts (LeetCode Ingestion)"] POP["React 18 Popup Dashboard"] WEL["React 18 Options Hub"] end subgraph ServiceWorker["Background Service Worker"] SW["Service Worker Controller"] QM["Durable Storage & FIFO Queue"] HS["Historical Catch-Up Engine"] GC["GitHub Git Data API Client"] end subgraph RemoteEndpoints["Remote Endpoints"] LC["LeetCode GraphQL API"] GH["GitHub REST & Git Data APIs"] end CS -->|"Submission Payload"| SW POP -->|"Status Query & Sync Trigger"| SW WEL -->|"Auth Token & Target Repo"| SW SW --> QM SW --> GC HS -->|"Paginated Solved Query"| LC HS -->|"Atomic Batch Commit Chain"| GC GC -->|"Direct Tree & Ref Commits"| GH ``` For in-depth subsystem blueprints and sequence diagrams, explore the [System Architecture Overview](docs/architecture/overview.md). --- ## 🚀 Quick Start & Installation ### 1. Build from Source ```bash # Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/Inkesk-Dozing/LeetLogger.git cd LeetLogger # Install dependencies npm install # Build the production extension package npm run build ``` ### 2. Load into Google Chrome 1. Open Chrome and navigate to `chrome://extensions/`. 2. Toggle on **Developer mode** in the top-right corner. 3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the generated `dist/` directory inside `LeetLogger`. 4. Click the **LeetLogger** icon in your browser toolbar to link your GitHub repository and begin tracking! ### 3. GitHub Authentication (100% Free & Secure) LeetLogger operates with zero intermediate servers, communicating directly from your browser to the GitHub API: 1. Open the LeetLogger Dashboard (click extension icon -> Options). 2. Generate a [Fine-Grained Personal Access Token (Recommended)](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new): - **Repository access**: Select **Only select repositories** (e.g. `LeetCode-Track`) or **All repositories** (if auto-creating new repos). - **Repository permissions**: **Contents: Read and write** (and automatic Metadata: Read-only). 3. Paste the `github_pat_...` token and link your repository. All credentials remain encrypted locally in your browser's `chrome.storage.local`. --- ## 📁 Repository Structure ``` LeetLogger/ ├── .github/ # CI/CD pipelines & CodeQL security scans │ └── workflows/ # ci.yml and codeql.yml ├── assets/ # Master visual branding, logos, and extension icons ├── docs/ # Technical Documentation │ ├── architecture/ # Subsystem blueprints & sequence diagrams │ ├── api/ # GitHub REST & Git Data API integration spec │ ├── components/ # Component contracts & Big-O complexity specs │ └── security/ # Threat model matrix & CSP definitions ├── src/ │ ├── manifest.json # Chrome Manifest V3 configuration │ ├── core/ # Pure TypeScript engines (Git, Storage, Formatters) │ ├── platform/ # LeetCode DOM observers & GraphQL fetchers │ ├── background/ # Background service worker & sync orchestrators │ ├── content/ # Web page DOM and OAuth interceptors │ └── ui/ # React 18 Popup and Options onboarding dashboards ├── webpack.config.js # Webpack 5 production build config ├── tsconfig.json # TypeScript configuration └── LICENSE # Apache 2.0 License ``` --- ## 📄 License Licensed under the [Apache License, Version 2.0](LICENSE).
